headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing them a decisive loss. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, outscoring them 4-3, with Eli White leading the Athletics' offense with 3 hits in 4 at-bats. The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates in a lopsided 11-1 victory, with Sean Manaea leading the way for the Mets, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Griffin Jax, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to right elbow discomfort. Other injured players include Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers), Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), and Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox).

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.
